experiment: reproduction of 0.03m MAD as artifact of zero-inflated train
user_observation: GP spatial 5-fold CV gives MAD 0.038 on real dH, but same number on pure noise → 0.03 is artifact
mechanism: v11 train set: 163/174 (94%) of points have |dH|<0.01 because they are used as prior anchors in v8/v9b pipeline (detail=24). MAD is a median statistic; with 94% zeros in train, median(|dH|) ≈ 0 regardless of model output. This is a SAMPLE-COMPOSITION LEAK, not a spatial leak — no spatial CV can fix it.
implications: 05_ml_residual_correction.py is a NEGATIVE result — do not use ml_gp_model.pkl in production
v8 must NOT be modified (real verified gain: detail 23 MAD 2.031 → 1.074)
The 0.03 m number is NOT a result of ML learning signal — it is fully reproduced by zero-inflated noise
No "spatial CV" can fix this — the leak is in sample composition, not geography
Recommendation to remove passport-train from prior is WRONG: trades verified v8 gain for hypothetical artifact derived from the leak
rejected_recommendations: ❌ "Remove passport train from prior to let ML find signal" — based on artifact, would lose real v8 gain
❌ "MAD will drop to ~0.5 m after ML" — extrapolated from 0.03 artifact
❌ "GP Matern is the right ML method" — gives same result on pure noise
